description: Detection rules (Splunk ESCU, Elastic, Sigma, Hayabusa and ThreatNexus hunting queries) that cover an actor's documented ATT&CK techniques. Metadata, covered techniques, licence and permalink — not the rule bodies. Considers up to 20 of the actor's techniques; for per-technique counts use get_attack_coverage.

actor.description: Actor name, alias or ThreatNexus slug, for example "MuddyWater", "Seedworm" or "muddywater".

name: map_actor_to_detections
title: Detection rules for an actor's techniques
